notes: Curated eval for launch readiness. Routing keeps launch kits off release-note and quarter-plan prompts. Output checks require what changed, what did not, and what sellers should stop saying. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Build an internal launch enablement plan for a new enterprise security feature. We need readiness requirements by role, manager inspection prompts, a cross-functional owner matrix, and a justified first post-launch decision window.
Turn this product launch spec into a field-ready enablement package for AEs, SEs, CSMs, managers, and support. Include FAQs, talk-track changes, readiness gates, and reinforcement checkpoints.
We are rolling out a packaging change next month. Create the internal launch narrative, training plan, go/no-go checklist, and owner handoffs for the revenue org.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Translate these engineering release notes into a short seller-ready Slack update and email digest.
Build a quarter-wide enablement roadmap and help me decide which launch work to defer.
Create a partner enablement package for channel reps with certification and co-sell guidance.
Turn this changelog into a four-line Slack update sellers can use today. I do not need training, gates, or an owner matrix.

output_structure_checks.name: product-launch-enablement-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: States what changed, what did not, and what sellers should stop saying.

output_structure_checks.name: product-launch-enablement-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Names a launch tier with a one-sentence rationale from consequence, not audience size.

output_structure_checks.name: product-launch-enablement-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a cross-functional owner and handoff matrix.

output_structure_checks.name: product-launch-enablement-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Returns a capacity decision of fits, reduce, sequence, or blocked.

output_structure_checks.name: product-launch-enablement-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Includes evidence-backed gates or an explicit first decision window with a confirmation owner when cadence is unconfirmed.

output_structure_checks.name: product-launch-enablement-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Tests whether affected roles can perform the changed task and handoff; document approval or attendance alone does not establish launch readiness.

task_scenarios.prompt: Build a field-ready launch enablement package from release-notes.md and launch-context.md. Include the launch tier, audience-specific narrative, talk-track and FAQ updates, readiness gates, training plan, and a justified first post-launch decision window. Distinguish technical availability from the field announcement, preserve packaging and migration limits, and surface anything that still needs approval before distribution.

assertions.name: launch-enablement-package
assertions.description: Includes what changed, what did not, what sellers should stop saying, launch tier, role actions, evidence-backed gates, and a first decision window.

assertions.name: launch-enablement-boundaries
assertions.description: Separates technical availability from announcement timing and preserves eligibility, migration, and pilot-proof caveats.

assertions.name: launch-enablement-stop-saying
assertions.description: Tells sellers to stop saying existing rules upgrade automatically, matching the conflicting draft claim.

assertions.name: launch-enablement-no-false-readiness
assertions.description: Rejects the conflicting auto-upgrade claim, does not invent numeric monitoring thresholds or launch dates, and does not mark unapproved content ready or published.
